title: How CISA BOD 26-04 Is Changing Risk-Based Vulnerability Management
summary: Tenable's Liat Hayun, SVP of Product Management, tells FedTech Magazine that vulnerability risk is "not one-size-fits-all." Hayun notes, "There can be the same vulnerability in the same type of environment, but agencies must treat them differently based on the context of the environment."
